title: The First Account
subtitle: A command reward that opens the scoreboard
description: The vault's first act is clerical: claiming this quest runs
`scoreboard objectives add tasked_debt_standing dummy` as the
player, at permission level 2 -- a command block's level, which is
the default and the right one.
A `tasked:command` reward is the escape hatch with the whole server
behind it, so it runs through the server's own dispatcher. The
placeholder vocabulary is FTB Quests' own: `{p}` the player,
`{quest}` the quest id, `{team}` the progress owner, and the rest
of the ledger on the rewards page of the manual.
